## Notes

- Axis Strategic Airforce Commitment Chart, 44.41. Read twice, from the archive.org scan (jp2 177, the Axis chart set) and the community chart PDFs (Axis Charts.pdf p. 35): 0 of 24 cells differ.
- levels I-IV: the number of Game-Turns of Axis strategic bombing of Malta each availability level may be used for; 'unlimited'; null where printed na (not allowed). The Last Chance has no Malta (chart footnote).
- scenarios maps each printed row to scenario ids; the chart has no rows for the Italian Campaign or the Desert Fox campaign.
